description: THE INSTRUCTION->PLAN DECISION LAYER as DATA (fixes meta-gaps 1/3/4). Two graph-resident Programs, the twins of control_kinds' classify_kind_family StringIndexOf-overlap Argmax: (1) capability_match is an Argmax over OperationalCapability by the OVERLAP score between a clause's content tokens (the has_token neighbours of the clause node bound as env `cl`) and each capability's token_blob (Count of clause tokens found as substrings, via StringIndexOf > -1) — it returns the best-matching operational capability, so 'bulk load' -> bulk_load, 'measure timing' -> measure_timing, 'other gaps' -> perceive_gaps, NOT an ink letter; (2) capability_match_score is that same overlap Count for ONE capability (env cl+cap), the numeric the parser reads to reject a zero-overlap pick (a mechanical boolean read, the twin of should_continue's 1.0/0.0). The clause->capability MATCH is the Argmax's output; the parser only sequences + reads. The if-then guard's threshold is a stated POLICY (FixWorthPolicy, graph data) the authored cond Term reads.

microtheory.name: operational_planning
microtheory.description: how a natural-language operational instruction becomes an ordered plan of capability-bound steps: each clause is matched to an OperationalCapability by the capability_match overlap Argmax; the order/nesting is graph structure; the executor enacts, never decides.

attrs.name: default_fix_worth_policy
attrs.description: the normalized-salience bar a perceived gap must clear for an if-then 'if it is worth fixing' guard to fire the fix substep. A stated POLICY (graph data, tunable), read by the authored cond Term (Gt(it.norm_salience, threshold)); NOT a Python literal.
